units.source_text: 两个从前专门做镇上大兵生意的女人，到了贴邻的妓馆。

en.t: Two women who had once made their living mainly from the soldiers in town went to the brothel next door.

units.source_text: 相反地，阿笑却被拉到上游的一家新馆去了，而且身价百倍。

en.t: By contrast, Axiao was taken off to a new establishment upstream, and her value rose a hundredfold.

units.source_text: 然而，阿清不到五天，又卧床不起了。

en.t: However, before five days had passed, Aqing was bedridden again.
